How to install on your phone

Every tool works immediately in your browser, and you can pin apps directly to your home screen with full native feel.

01

Open Google Play Store

Tap “Get it on Google Play” to jump straight to our verified pl.cclite.app listing.

02

Download completely free

Zero subscription paywalls, zero annoying video ads, safe for everyday devotion.

03

Listen & study anywhere

Play 24/7 radio streams, Biblia Audio chapters and daily inspirations in the background.

01

Visit any CC app in Chrome

Open cclite.pl, christian-culture.web.app, polskieradio.cc/lumina or /mojabiblia.

02

Tap “Add to Home screen”

Open Chrome’s top-right menu and select Install app / Add to Home screen.

03

Launch full-screen anytime

A crisp Christian Culture icon appears in your Android launcher without browser bars.

01

Open the URL in Safari

Navigate on iPhone or iPad to cclite.pl or any Christian Culture web application.

02

Tap the Share button

At the bottom of Safari, tap the Share icon and scroll through the action sheet.

03

Select “Add to Home Screen”

Confirm the shortcut name — your app now launches cleanly in standalone mode.
